description: This file contains unit tests for the UtilGenerics class, verifying generic collection handling and type safety.

classes.name: UtilGenericsTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the methods of UtilGenerics utility class.

methods.name: basicCheckCollection
methods.description: Tests that UtilGenerics.checkCollection correctly processes a collection of strings.

methods.name: incompatibleCollectionCheckCollection
methods.description: Ensures that UtilGenerics.checkCollection throws ClassCastException when provided a non-collection object.

methods.name: heterogenousCheckCollection
methods.description: Verifies that UtilGenerics.checkCollection throws IllegalArgumentException when collection contains mixed types.

methods.name: nullCheckCollection
methods.description: Checks that UtilGenerics.checkCollection returns null when input is null.
